Rita: FYI apac-edge-rack7 p95 climbed at 09:04 JST, looks like NIC queue + gpu-kv spill at same time. Any oncall?
Omar: I'm on it, pulling host metrics. host-7-02 shows nic_tx_queue_len=260, pci_util=88%, kworker backlog up.
Ben: Are these dedicated slices or shared?
Omar: Two dedicated tenants on host-7-02: retail-asia-ded and vision-research-ded. InfraBot alert suppressed auto-evict due to dedicated tag.
InfraBot: [alert] nic-pileup@rack7 hosts=[host-7-02] duration=45s severity=medium auto_action=none reason=dedicated-slice
Rita: Retail tenant reported a new sampling rollout at 08:50 with larger batch_size. Could be noisy neighbor inside dedicated slice.
Ben: Proposal: non-disruptive reroute of retail-asia-ded to warmed burst-pool in same region + attach ephemeral ratecap to limit egress to 280mbit for 15m. Keep KV warm to avoid cold-start latency.
Omar: Command run: `allocator move-tenant --tenant=retail-asia-ded --target=burst-pool-apac --preserve-kv --reason "egress saturation"`
Omar: Allocator: handoff accepted; warming on burst-pool-apac. Applying egress profile `ephemeral-280mbit`
Ben: Also apply tc on host-7-02 to protect co-tenants: `tc qdisc add dev eth0 root tbf rate 600mbit burst 64kb latency 100ms` and configure cgroup for tenant process.
Rita: After move p95 for rack7 dropped from 520ms -> 120ms in ~90s. host nic queue drained.
BillingBot: Notice: burst-pool will incur premium; estimated delta so far: +0.6 GPU-hrs, est cost +$0.80. Billing event will be attached to tenant account.
Ben: Follow-ups: we should add a per-tenant opt-in toggle for "transient-burst-allow" on dedicated slices and display expected burst cost in console before handoff. Also a scheduler rule: if nic_tx_queue_len>200 for >30s and host in dedicated, trigger recommended action but don't auto-evict.
Omar: Root cause confirmed: retail team accidentally switched to beam_search with beam=256 and increased batch_size in their rollout. We've asked them to roll back.
Rita: Filing INFRA-5001 to track changes: scheduler rule + tenant opt-in + billing annotation + console UX. Assign infra-scheduler and billing.
InfraBot: Ticket INFRA-5001 created (owner=infra-scheduler, priority=high).
Ben: Keeping burst move for 20m, then revert if stable. Notify tenant owners before revert.
Rita: Thanks all, good recovery. Will add remediation notes to the ticket :white_check_mark:
